_comment: ADR-12 build-time compliance scan manifest. The three scan_faces are fixed by the ADR-12 ruling and MUST NOT be renamed, removed or added to. scan_compliance.py refuses to run (exit 4) if this list drifts, and tests/compliance_injection_test.py independently re-asserts it.
authority: PRD section 2.4 X-2 / section 2.6 P0-26 W-1 W-2
_channel_parity: Scan face 1 must cover every channel a refund string can reach the customer through, including the ones that are easy to forget. Omitting a channel is exactly the 'the page was changed but the push template was not' silent-failure mode. These are the six channels named by ADR-12 plus the api path list from contract L603.

scan1_refund.rationale: The client mini-program package must contain no refund wording, in any channel. Internal documents and the manager / therapist surfaces are not scanned here: refund wording is a legitimate internal business term there. The second root is the REAL mini-program project (G-B B-3, 2026-09-28): until it was added here, the discipline covered only the sample package, and the real project was an unscanned word surface -- the build-check covered it locally, but a local check is not a gate.

scan2_negative.rationale: The client must not surface negative counting or gap-attribution wording; missing band data must never be imputed as 0, and must never be described as a medical basis. Second root = the real mini-program project (B-3).

scan3_derived.rationale: Derived fields and derived verdicts are server-side only; the client must not even name them, since the internal gap-reason enum and the client sync-state enum are two independent enum namespaces. Second root = the real mini-program project (B-3).
